capabilities: List the Git history of the active note
Replace the note's tab with a two-column diff against a chosen commit
Highlight removed and added text inline with collapsible unchanged ranges
Edit the current note in the diff pane and save changes automatically
Follow older versions of notes renamed in Git
extras: Desktop only (needs Node child_process); requires a vault inside a Git working tree and git on the system PATH. Distribution is via BRAT or manual installation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see what changed between a note and its earlier Git revisions while continuing to edit it.

relations.evidence: The Obsidian Git plugin is optional. It is a convenient way to create and sync commits

summary: Side-by-side Git diff view that compares the note you are editing against any past commit, with an editable current-version pane.
